t: This augment can be added to any module.$(p)Normally, modules are run when the router runs, no questions asked. However, if this augment is added to a module, that module can define its own redstone behaviour; an extra button is added to the module's GUI to control this.
这个增强件可以添加到任何模块中。$(p)通常情况下，模块会在路由器运行时直接执行，不作任何判断。不过，如果给模块添加了这个增强件，该模块就可以定义自己的红石行为；模块 GUI 中也会额外出现一个按钮用于控制这一点。
